instruction: A candid cinematic medium shot captures an indoor office setting next to a large window. On the left, the woman in the white shirt and glasses (R1) stands facing right, holding an open notebook and gesturing with a pen as she speaks. On the right, the woman in the dark vest (R2) stands in profile facing left, holding a dark mug and listening attentively. The two women stand close together, engaged in a collaborative discussion over the notebook. Soft, natural daylight diffuses from the window, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the warm brick wall on the far left.
